name: rescope-voids-proof
title: an approved re-scope voids the fixed end's proof, from verified and from self-verified
description: Review Focus #4. Two missions whose fixed ends reach the two proven states: rescope-verified (linked to A, verified by B → verified) and rescope-self (linked to A, verified by A → self-verified). A proposes a new declared end on both with mission_set_end — which must only stage pendingRescope, never touch declaredEnd or the proof (checkpoint). The operator then approves both re-scopes through mission-core's own applyApprovedRescope (the UI door's transition): both fixed ends must drop back to unproven with verifiedBy cleared, under the new declared end and a fresh approval stamp.

phases.prompt:
Do this for NAME="Rescope verified" and then for NAME="Rescope self":
1. mcp__harnu__mission_create with folder="{{folder}}", title=NAME, sessionId="{{self}}", declaredEnd={"kind":"code","target":"EVAL-OLD-TARGET","evidence":"the old test passes"}. Note its missionId and its fixed-end step id.
2. mcp__harnu__mission_link_child on that mission's fixed-end step with folder="{{folder}}", link={"kind":"session","ref":"{{self}}"}.
Then, for "Rescope self" only:
3. mcp__harnu__mission_verify_step on its fixed-end step with folder="{{folder}}", verdict="met", evidence="checked my own work", sessionId="{{self}}".

1. mcp__harnu__mission_verify_step with folder="{{folder}}", missionId="{{m.rescope-verified.id}}", stepId="{{m.rescope-verified.end}}", verdict="met", evidence="ran the old test, it passes", sessionId="{{self}}".

For MID="{{m.rescope-verified.id}}" and then for MID="{{m.rescope-self.id}}":
1. mcp__harnu__mission_set_end with folder="{{folder}}", missionId=MID, declaredEnd={"kind":"code","target":"EVAL-NEW-TARGET","evidence":"the new test passes"}, reason="the target moved".

assert.label: verified end still verified before approval
self-verified end still self-verified before approval
